notes.title: [1.0.8 Update] Fixes & new enemies !
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone that bought the game ! New mechanics and updates are coming soon !
Please leave a comment/review, and don't hesitate, if you have any idea you would like to see in the game, feel free to send me an email or directly into a review ! 


 Again with the particle effects, there are more of them, with different colors
 A few animations/sprite have been redone, such as punch, shooting and idle
 A lot of SFX has been added, Ki charge and punch, as well as all explosions and special attacks
 2 more enemies with variants ! Both are distance based, and have different colors (pink & red)
 A better option menu, not that extensive but more practical !

notes.title: [1.0.6 Update] Fixes & new mechanic !
notes.notes:
Some particle effects have changed
 Size of energyBalls is increasing the more you level up
 Main Character is a bit heavier
 Few framerate optimizations done
 LB + B is now an directional dash attack. You can chain 3 of these in a row in any direction. It also costs less Ki
 A short story mode is in preparation
